text:
elaine_marketing: Quick sync — we need a clean keyword + schema handoff for the webinar landing and post-webinar evergreen blog. TL;DR: content needs keywords, JSON-LD, canonical, internal linking map, and redirect plan for old blog pages. Can people +1 if they can review today? Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EXAMPLE (internal) @devin_seo @leah_content

devin_seo: +1. I'll drop a keyword seed list and a schema checklist. Plan to push JSON-LD for Event and FAQ. Also add breadcrumbList for nav. Will add to sheet.

leah_content: Got it. I can map keywords to headings and existing blog posts. Will flag where we need new redirects.

miguel_growth: Heads up — we'll want UTM routing for webinar assets. Proposed utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=llm_serving_launch. Also need to route post-webinar leads to the dedicated demo flow.

devin_seo: In sheet I set columns: "redirect_from" / "redirect_to" / "http_code" / "notes". Example entries: /old-webinar => /webinars/serve-llm-economical (301). Use 301 for permanent redirects.

elaine_marketing: can we standardize canonical tag on event landing to avoid duplicate AMP/mirror pages?

devin_seo: Yes. canonical -> https://redwood.inference/webinars/serve-llm-economical. Also add <link rel=\"alternate\" hreflang=\"en-us\"/> if we later localize.

leah_content: For internal linking matrix I propose: landing -> benchmark post -> deep-dive -> product features page -> demo sign-up. I'll add anchor text suggestions in sheet (short CTAs + long-form anchors for SEO).

devin_seo: Quick JSON-LD snippet (pasting to sheet so eng/content can QA):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Serving LLMs: Production Patterns",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T17:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinars/serve-llm-economical"}
}
```

miguel_growth: Also propose redirect rule to include utm rewrite so partner links map. Example nginx snippet we can ask eng to implement: `rewrite ^/partner/old$ /webinars/serve-llm-economical?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=referral permanent;`

sam_product: Eng can support a small redirect table in CDN (Fastly). Send final CSV (columns: source_url,target_url,status,notes) and we'll queue it.

devin_seo: I'll export redirect CSV by EOD and tag eng. Quick QA checklist: run URL inspection in Search Console, fetch as Google, mobile rendering check, schema validator, and run internal link crawler to catch orphan pages.

elaine_marketing: Perfect. @leah_content can you confirm the webinar blog draft includes the two primary keywords: "LLM inference cost optimization" and "production LLM serving" by EOD? If yes, we can lock canonical and push redirect CSV.

leah_content: Confirmed. I'll tag changes in the doc and update the sheet with anchor text + suggested CTAs.

seo-ci-bot: Reminder: scheduled crawler run at 1834507000 triggered — will report broken links and any 4xx/5xx from the redirect table check.
